description: This PHP class 'ReviewEmployeeSupervisorAPI' defines a REST API endpoint for listing supervisors of an employee within a Human Resource Management system. It utilizes specific framework traits and annotations for API documentation. The class handles retrieval of supervisor data with filtering, sorting, and pagination support, and adheres to the project’s API design conventions.
